pages.text: The cold here has three faces.$(br2)$(l)Frostbite$() is what the king's servants leave in you: it slows, it bites, and it will not let you heal. Against it there are potions of warmth - nobody knows how to brew them, so do not waste them.

$(l)The Chill$() is laid by the Crown over the citadel on everyone who does not carry fire at their breast. Nothing washes it off.$(br2)$(l)Heart's Frost$() is born of the hearts in the trap rooms. Only a burning hearth helps against it - nothing else.

pages.title: Potion of Warmth
pages.text: The expedition's fire sealed in brass. Thrown, it bursts: a minute of warmth for all within four blocks - throw it at your feet to warm yourself. Only in chests: camp, tower and citadel.
